code.title: Get a code — BipAgents
code.description: Join the BipAgents beta with your own Hermes, no code and no limit, or with an all-included server: your code shows up right away.

code.title: How do you want to use BipAgents?
code.ownTitle: I want to use my Hermes
code.ownText: On your computer or your server: one command, then you scan the QR code in the app. No code, no limit.
code.placeText: Your private server in Europe, with the AI credit. Free during the beta.
code.again: You already asked for it: it’s the same code.
code.step2: In the app, choose “I have an invitation code” and paste your code.
code.fine: One code per address. Your address is read for a moment, only to send you your code, through Proton AG (Switzerland). We don’t keep it: we only keep fingerprints computed with a secret key (pseudonymous data), one to check that an address gets only one code, until 31 December 2026 at the latest, the other, made from your address and a random ticket that only your browser keeps, for one day, to show you the same code if you ask again from this browser. Proton keeps the sent message until we delete it from the outbox. Disposable addresses are refused, and the anti-bot check stores nothing on your device. Legal bases: sending what you ask for (GDPR art. 6(1)(b)) and preventing abuse (art. 6(1)(f)).
